query:
SELECT 
  id,
  name,
  username,
  loginMethod,
  passwordHash,
  CASE 
    WHEN passwordHash IS NOT NULL THEN 'Yes'
    ELSE 'No'
  END as has_password
FROM users 
WHERE name = 'jiang';
